slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
天武大陆，大周王朝，清月镇，江家大殿。
众多江家族人聚集在江家大殿。
“噗。
“一道劲气击在一名年轻男子江尘的腹部，直接打出一个血洞。
“啊……”
江尘惨叫一声，瞬间倒地，他看向眼前的女子一脸不可思议。
江尘，十八岁，江家天才弟子，武者境二重。
出手之人正是他的青梅竹马兼未婚妻柳芸。
柳芸虽然长相出众，但是此时的她神色冰冷，没有丝毫情感。
“柳芸，你居然废了吾儿江尘的修为，你太狠了。”
一个看起来三十多岁的男子江云风大怒道，说完，他直接向眼前的柳芸出手。
江云风是江尘的父亲，看到儿子被废掉修为，如何不怒？
结果，一道强大的劲气袭来击中男子，男子瞬间被击飞，撞在墙上，吐出大口鲜血。
出手的人，是站在柳芸身旁的年轻男子，这个男子是柳芸的师兄陈昂，一个武宗境六重的强者。
江云风只是武师境五重，怎么可能是对手？
境界从低到高分为武徒境，武者境，武师境，武宗境，武王境，武皇境，武尊境，武圣境，武帝境，武神境。
每一大境界又分十重小境界。
在柳芸的身边，还有其他几个武宗境的师兄。
“爹……”
倒在地上的江尘惊呼道，他一动便扯动了腹部的伤口，痛得他咬牙切齿。

“咳……”
江云风艰难地从地面爬起来，嘴角溢血。
周围的江家族人面色一变，一脸怒意地盯着柳芸等人，虽然愤怒，但是对方实力太强了，没有人敢上前。
“柳芸，你废了我的修为也就罢了，还打伤我爹，你这个忘恩负义的女人。”
江尘充满恨意地道。
柳芸闻言，脸色阴睛不定，不过，为了追逐更强的实力，她必须这么做。
“我这么做，也是为了你们好，江尘，这一次，算是我对不起你，但是你们不能阻止我的追求。”
柳芸平静地道。
“哈哈，口口声声地为了我们好，但是却废了我的修为，打伤我爹。”
江尘大怒道，现在江尘体内的真气溢散，修为全无，身体上的伤害远比不上心灵上的伤害。
不过，众人没有注意到，江尘身上的血沾染到他胸前的黑色珠子上，被珠子吸收了进去。
这黑色珠子是江尘一个月前在外面捡到的，十分坚硬，江尘用绳子将其环绕绑好，戴在身上。
十二年前，青月镇四大家族之一的柳家一夜之间被灭门。
当时还是五岁的柳芸躲在一个枯井里，所以躲过了一劫，成为柳家唯一幸存者。
柳家被灭门，在青月镇引起轰动，事后，江云风在枯井里发现了柳芸，于是将柳芸带回家里抚养。
柳芸从小就跟江尘亲近，江云风也很喜欢柳芸，便给二人定下婚约，小时候，柳芸一直跟在江尘的身后，一口一句江尘哥哥地叫着。
content_en:
Tianwu Continent, Great Zhou Dynasty, Qingyue Town, Jiang Family Hall.
Many Jiang family members gathered in the Jiang family hall.
"Pfft.
"A powerful force hit the abdomen of a young man, Jiang Chen, and directly made a bloody hole.
"Ah..."
Jiang Chen screamed and fell to the ground instantly. He looked at the woman in front of him with a look of disbelief.
Jiang Chen, eighteen years old, is a genius disciple of the Jiang family and is at the second level of the warrior realm.
The person who took action was none other than his childhood sweetheart and fiancée Liu Yun.
Although Liu Yun was outstanding in appearance, her expression was cold and emotionless at this time.
"Liu Yun, you actually ruined my son Jiang Chen's cultivation. You are too cruel."
Jiang Yunfeng, a man who looked to be in his thirties, said angrily. After speaking, he directly attacked Liu Yun in front of him.
Jiang Yunfeng was Jiang Chen's father. How could he not be angry when he saw his son's cultivation was abolished?
As a result, a powerful force hit the man. The man was instantly knocked away and hit the wall, spitting out a large mouthful of blood.
The person who took action was the young man standing next to Liu Yun. This man was Liu Yun's senior brother Chen Ang, a strong man at the sixth level of the Wuzong Realm.
Jiang Yunfeng is only at the fifth level of the martial arts realm, how could he be his opponent?
The realms from low to high are divided into the martial disciple realm, the warrior realm, the martial master realm, the martial ancestral realm, the martial king realm, the martial emperor realm, the martial supreme realm, the martial saint realm, the martial emperor realm, and the martial god realm.
Each major realm is divided into ten smaller realms.
Beside Liu Yun, there were several other senior brothers from the Wuzong Realm.
"Dad..."
Jiang Chen, who was lying on the ground, exclaimed. The wound on his abdomen was pulled open when he moved, causing him to grit his teeth in pain.
"Ahem..."
Jiang Yunfeng struggled to get up from the ground, blood bleeding from the corner of his mouth.
The expressions of the surrounding Jiang family members changed, and they stared at Liu Yun and others angrily. Although they were angry, the other party was too strong, and no one dared to step forward.
"Liu Yun, you just crippled my cultivation, but you also injured my father, you ungrateful woman."
Jiang Chen said with hatred.
Liu Yun had a gloomy look on her face when she heard this, but in order to pursue greater strength, she had to do this.
"I'm doing this for your own good, Jiang Chen. This time, I feel sorry for you, but you can't stop my pursuit."
Liu Yun said calmly.
"Haha, he kept saying he was doing it for our own good, but he ruined my cultivation and injured my father."
Jiang Chen said angrily, now the true energy in Jiang Chen's body has overflowed, his cultivation is completely gone, and the physical damage is far less than the mental damage.
However, no one noticed that the blood on Jiang Chen's body was stained on the black beads on his chest and was absorbed by the beads.
This black bead was picked up by Jiang Chen outside a month ago. It was very hard. Jiang Chen tied it with a rope and wore it on his body.
Twelve years ago, the Liu family, one of the four major families in Qingyue Town, was wiped out overnight.
Liu Yun, who was still five years old at the time, escaped by hiding in a dry well and became the only survivor of the Liu family.
The Liu family was wiped out, causing a sensation in Qingyue Town. Afterwards, Jiang Yunfeng found Liu Yun in a dry well, so he took Liu Yun home to raise him.
Liu Yun had been close to Jiang Chen since she was a child. Jiang Yunfeng also liked Liu Yun very much, so he made an engagement for the two of them. When she was a child, Liu Yun had been following Jiang Chen, calling Jiang Chen brother.
